name: Vegetable Oats Upma
ingredients: ½ cup diced mixed vegetables (carrot, peas and beans)
steps: Toast oats in a dry pan for 2–3 minutes until fragrant; transfer to a bowl.
Heat oil in the pan. Add mustard, cumin, curry leaves and chilli; let the seeds pop.
Add onion and vegetables. Cook 3–4 minutes, stirring, until they begin to soften.
Add water and salt. Bring to a simmer, then stir in oats.
Cook 3–4 minutes until creamy but not mushy. Finish with lemon, coriander and sunflower seeds.
note: Rolled oats cook quickly; steel-cut oats need a different liquid ratio and longer cooking.
